raw.overview:
New Content 
 Nahida Sara can buff Nahida with her kit. Otherwise, they have no clear synergy or noteworthy interaction with each other. 
 Playstyles 
 Burst DPS Buffer 
 Kujou Sara’s primary role in teams is to act as a potent buffer to complement short duration but high impact skills or skills that snapshot, while concurrently doing considerable Elemental Burst damage.
 Talent Priority 
 Skill ≥ Burst > Normal Attack
 Leveling Sara’s Normal Attack is not recommended.
 Talents 
 Normal Attack
 Elemental Skill
 Elemental Burst
 Ascension 1 Passive
 Ascension 4 Passive
 Normal Attack
 Normal Attack | Tengu Bowmanship 
 Talent Description
 Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow. 
 Charged Attack
Perform a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, crackling lightning will accumulate on the arrowhead. An arrow fully charged with the storm's might will deal Electro DMG.
When in the Crowfeather Cover state, a fully-charged arrow will leave a Crowfeather behind after it hits. 
 Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact. 
 Sara’s Normal Attack is fairly unimpressive and can be neglected.
 Elemental Skill
 Elemental Skill | Tengu Stormcall 
 Talent Description
 Retreats rapidly with the speed of a tengu, summoning the protection of the Crowfeather.
Gains Crowfeather Cover for 18s, and when Kujou Sara fires a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Crowfeather Cover will be consumed, and will leave a Crowfeather at the target location.
Crowfeathers will trigger Tengu Juurai: Ambush after a short time, dealing Electro DMG and granting the active character within its AoE an ATK Bonus based on Kujou Sara's Base ATK. 
 The ATK Bonuses from different Tengu Juurai will not stack, and their effects and duration will be determined by the last Tengu Juurai to take effect. 
 Arguably the most important part of her kit. The higher the Talent level of Sara’s Elemental Skill, the stronger her buff becomes.
 Elemental Burst
 Elemental Burst | Subjugation: Koukou Sendou 
 Talent Description
 Casts down Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Afterwards, Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker spreads out into 4 consecutive bouts of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
Tengu Juurai: Titanbreaker and Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster can provide the active character within their AoE with the same ATK Bonus as given by the Elemental Skill, Tengu Stormcall. 
 The ATK Bonus provided by various kinds of Tengu Juurai will not stack, and their effects and duration will be determined by the last Tengu Juurai to take effect. 
 The bulk of Sara’s damage. The on-field character can be buffed by Sara after being hit by a Stormcluster. While leveling her Elemental Burst does not make her buff stronger, it is still recommended to be leveled to maximize Sara’s damage.
 Ascension 1 Passive
 Ascension 1 Passive | Immovable Will 
 Talent Description
 While in the Crowfeather Cover state provided by Tengu Stormcall, Aimed Shot charge times are decreased by 60%. 
 For players without Sara’s C2, this is a consolation and reduces the clunkiness of applying her buff by a significant amount.
 Ascension 4 Passive
 Ascension 4 Passive | Decorum 
 Talent Description
 When Tengu Juurai: Ambush hits opponents, Kujou Sara will restore 1.2 Energy to all party members for every 100% Energy Recharge she has. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. 
 Another QoL passive. Sara is an Energy-hungry character and this passive reduces her ER requirements.
 Constellations 
 Constellation 1
 Constellation 2
 Constellation 3
 Constellation 4
 Constellation 5
 Constellation 6
 Constellation 1
 Constellation 1 | Crow's Eye 
 Constellation Description
 When Tengu Juurai grant characters ATK Bonuses or hits opponents, the CD of Tengu Stormcall is decreased by 1s.
This effect can be triggered once every 3s. 
 Slight Elemental Skill CD reduction translates to being able to apply her buff more often.
 Constellation 2
 Constellation 2 | Dark Wings 
 Constellation Description
 Unleashing Tengu Stormcall will leave a weaker Crowfeather at Kujou Sara's original position that will deal 30% of its original DMG. 
 Significant QoL Constellation. Players can now buff the on-field character without using a fully-aimed Charged Shot, which significantly reduces the clunkiness of her kit.
 Constellation 3
 Constellation 3 | The War Within 
 Constellation Description
 Increases the Level of Subjugation: Koukou Sendou by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15. 
 Levels to Sara’s Elemental Burst.
 Constellation 4
 Constellation 4 | Conclusive Proof 
 Constellation Description
 The number of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster released by Subjugation: Koukou Sendou is increased to 6. 
 Sara’s Elemental Burst now has a bigger AoE, increasing damage and making buffing through her Elemental Burst much easier.
 Constellation 5
 Constellation 5 | Spellsinger 
 Constellation Description
 Increases the Level of Tengu Stormcall by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15. 
 Levels to Sara’s Elemental Skill.
 Constellation 6
 Constellation 6 | Sin of Pride 
 Constellation Description
 The Electro DMG of characters who have had their ATK increased by Tengu Juurai has its Crit DMG increased by 60%. 
 Sara’s best Constellation that can make gearing the team’s Electro DPS easier. Best utilized in teams that can frontload Electro damage. Alternatively, her buff can be reapplied at every possible opportunity for sustained damage dealers. This Constellation can be extended ever so slightly by hitlag and cannot be snapshotted.

raw.artifactSets:
4 Emblem of Severed Fate (4 ESF) BiS for personal damage. 
4 Noblesse Oblige (4 NO) Allows Sara to maximize her buffing capabilities if no one else already has this. 
4 Tenacity of the Millelith (4ToM) Allows players to maximize her buffing capabilities if another character already has 4 NO. 
Best used with characters who can snapshot the buff as Sara’s long Elemental Skill cooldown prevents the consistent trigger of the buff this set has. 
Any combo of 2 Emblem of Severed Fate (2 ESF)/2 Noblesse Oblige (2 NO)/2 Thundering Fury (2 TF)/2 ATK% (2ATK) Pick any two based on whichever has the best substats.
raw.weapons:
5-star Bow
 All 5-star Bows are good options as they come with high base ATK which automatically increases Sara’s buff regardless of whether the passive is of any use to her. 
Elegy for the End Elegy for the End is Sara’s best buffing weapon if she is able to trigger the passive. 
Skyward Harp Skyward Harp is Sara’s best generalist option, with a passive that increases her own personal damage and an unconditional stronger buff due to a higher weapon base ATK. 
 4-star Bows
 Players should opt to gear Sara with a Bow that has the highest base ATK after giving priority to the team's Main DPS 
Favonius Warbow Favonius Warbow can be an exception as it provides a lot of ER% and has team utility that can make Sara much more valuable in a team. 
Fading Twilight Fading Twilight is highly recommended as it is F2P and has everything Sara looks for.
raw.teams:
Team-Building 
- Sara should be paired with a DPS that has a quickswap playstyle, has high frontloaded damage or can snapshot buffs. 
- Players should pair Sara with another Electro character when possible for best results. 
- Sara can be a flex option as her ATK buff is short but universal. In most cases, however, there are better flex options. 
 Mono/Double Electro
 Sara shines the most in such teams. She can focus on offensive stats instead of ER% while buffing the team with her C6 on top of her ATK buff to deal large amounts of damage.
 Raiden-Centric
 Sara has undeniably high synergy with Raiden. They diminish each other’s flaws and deal significant amounts of damage in a short window via Raiden’s Burst, which is buffed by Sara.
 Electro-Charged
 Sara is able to buff both the on-field and off-field characters (provided they snapshot buffs), replacing the need for 2 off-field DPSes in a traditional Electro-Charged team. Both the on-field and off-field character can be either Electro or Hydro, provided there is sufficient application to trigger the reaction consistently.
 Notable Teammates 
 Raiden Shogun , Beidou , Keqing , Fischl , Yae Miko , Lisa On-field and off-field Electro DPSes who benefit significantly from Sara’s buffs. 
 Kamisato Ayato , Xiangling , Ningguang On-field and off-field non-Electro DPSes who benefit significantly from Sara’s buffs. 
 Xingqiu , Yelan Provide off-field Hydro application. 
 Bennett , Zhongli Bennett is a generalist buffer and healer. Gives extremely powerful buffs to the team when paired with Sara.
Zhongli combines offensive and defensive support via a strong shield, a universal 20% RES shred and ToM buffs. 
 V enti , K azuha , Jean , Sucrose Provide 40% Elemental RES Shred via Viridescent Venerer and an assortment of other buffs/grouping. 
 Example Teams 
 This is not a comprehensive list of teams, and the inclusion of a certain team or lack thereof does not necessarily indicate the power level of the team in question. This list is not ranked.
 Sara — Raiden — Yae — Kazuha 
(Mono Electro) 
 Sara — Raiden — Bennett — Kazuha 
(Raiden-Centric) 
 Sara — Ayato — Fischl — Bennett 
(Electro-Charged)
